title: SeasonSafe: Annualized commit buffer and rolling true-up window proposal for seasonal enterprise accounts
creator: Marco Reyes
description:
Problem: Several mid-market and enterprise customers have highly seasonal usage (quarterly spikes) causing frequent overage disputes and abrupt price increases at renewal. Current true-up policy (single static window at renewal + strict commit enforcement) creates churn risk and negotiation overhead for both Sales and Finance.

Goal: Design a pricing construct and operational flow that reduces renewal friction for seasonal customers while preserving revenue predictability and minimizing short-term leakage. Proposal combines: 1) an annualized commit buffer (SeasonSafe) that smooths expected usage over a contract year, 2) a rolling true-up window that allows one timed adjustment per quarter for revenue alignment, and 3) progressive multi-year uplift caps to make multi-year commitments attractive without exposing us to outsized tail risk.
acceptance_criteria: Define calculation for SeasonSafe annualized baseline (how to convert seasonal telemetry into an annual committed quantity)
Rollout policy documented: eligibility rules, one rolling true-up per quarter, and how additional true-ups are handled (pricing delta, approvals)
Revenue recognition & finance playbook updated to reflect deferred true-ups and uplift caps
Legal/Contract language template for multi-year uplift caps and SeasonSafe buffer included in renewal addenda
Pilot with at least 3 existing seasonal customers (one mid-market, two enterprise) signed to pilot terms before 2026-05-01
decisions: Use a 20% SeasonSafe buffer by default with +/- adjustments based on 12-month lookback variance (configurable per account)
Allow one rolling true-up per calendar quarter with a 30-day notification window; additional true-ups require RevOps approval
Apply multi-year uplift caps of 10%/year for year-over-year committed increases on 2-year deals and 7%/year on 3-year deals
True-ups under threshold of $2,000 / quarter will be aggregated and settled at renewal to reduce admin burden
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Internal): finalize formulas and legal templates; Finance to sign off on revenue handling — target 2 weeks
Phase 1 (Pilot): offer SeasonSafe plus rolling true-up to three pilot accounts; Sales/CS to capture feedback — target 6 weeks
Phase 2 (Tiered Launch): enable via Contract Addendum for eligible accounts with automation in renewal quoting tools — target Q2 2026
Phase 3 (GA): full productization, update pricing docs, sales playbook, and console alerts for true-up windows — target Q3 2026
